name: Anonymous Imageboard
summary: An anonymous board where each thread starts with an image: a pale page, posts with no account, post numbers, green quoted lines and threads that bump to the top and then fall off.

philosophy.core_thesis: Nobody has a name, so only the post counts; the newest reply keeps a thread alive.
design_principles: Start each thread with an image thumbnail of at most 250px at the left of the first post.
Sign each post 'Anonymous' with a date and a post number such as No.123456789.
Set a line that starts with > in green (#789922) as a quote or a story line.
Link a reply to an earlier post with >>123456789 in the link colour.
Put replies in boxes of a slightly darker tint than the page, stacked under the first post.
Show at most 10 pages of threads; a thread with a new reply moves to the top, and the last thread is deleted.
Use a centred board title at the top, with a short banner image above it.
anti_patterns: User accounts, avatars and like counts
Infinite feeds that keep old threads
Large white space and soft cards

layout.grid_mechanics: One full-width column; each thread is the first post with its image floated left, then reply boxes stacked under it.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 10% to 20% of the page stays empty; reply boxes have 2px to 4px padding.
layout.alignment_rules: Posts align left; the board title and the post form are centred.
layout.container_geometry: Reply boxes are rectangles with a 0px radius and a 1px border at the right and bottom only.

font_pairings.note: A default serif title and an Arial-like text, as on a stock board.
One sans for all text, as on the work-safe boards.

hierarchy_rules: Use 13px for posts and 28px for the board title.
Set the subject in bold blue and the name 'Anonymous' in bold green.
Set post numbers and dates at the post size, with no extra weight.

color.palette_structure: One of two stock themes: a pale peach page with maroon text, or a pale blue page with navy text; green for quotes.
color.contrast_rules: Maroon on peach is 10:1; quote green on peach is 3.6:1 and stays for short lines only.
color.surface_treatment: Flat tinted boxes with no texture.
color.light_and_shadow: No light source and no shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: A plain HTML page with JPEG thumbnails.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px border at the right and bottom of a reply box (#D9BFB7).

ornamentation_details.iconography: Almost none: a small sticky pin, a lock and country flags of 16px by 11px on some boards.
ornamentation_details.illustration: The posted images: reaction faces, memes and photos, in thumbnails that expand on click.

motion.transition_physics: No animation; a clicked thumbnail expands at once to the full image.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover on a >> link shows the quoted post in a floating box.

emotion.target_response: The reader feels the speed, the irony and the danger of a crowd with no names.

avoid_when: The audience needs trust or safety.
The brand needs identity and authorship.

modifiers.how: Add a user column with an avatar, a rank and a post count.
Set the posted images as image macros with white Impact captions.
Add vote arrows and sort the replies by score.

pack.why: Small pixel icons match the 16px pins and flags of a board.

ground.why: A stock HTML page: a flat tinted ground with nothing on it.
